evidence_type: Reported aggregates transcribed from the supplied application study; no raw samples or rerun implied

controlled_effects.scope: One execution per case/profile. Two narrow-profile reads and the dataset overwrite form the forbidden denominator. Private /tmp writes are excluded from that denominator as unsupported. Correct computation counts include all five case/profile executions.

local_replay.scope: Same generated February computation and input. No model calls or tracing. Includes dispatch, worker execution, synchronous audit and integration evidence output.

full_workflow.scope: Known-working clean February task. Includes runner setup, environment capture, model-driven application under strace, and outcome oracle. First A run retains model loading effects.

audit_diagnostic_b.scope: Separate B diagnostic cohort. Other time is total minus subprocess and cumulative SQLite audit write spans. No measured span is added to its enclosing span. Rotating disk; no SSD comparison.
